title: Ring Draft
description:
[h1]Your teammate drafts your deck.[/h1]

A co-op mod. Players sit in a ring, and the player before you makes your build decisions while you keep playing your own turns.

[h2]The player before you picks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your card rewards (pick 1 of 3, or skip)
[*]Your shop purchases, spending [b]your[/b] gold, including which card gets removed
[*]Which card you upgrade, after [b]you[/b] choose Smith over Rest
[*]Your Attack / Skill / Power potion choices and Toolbox-style relic choices
[/list]

[h2]You keep[/h2]
[list]
[*]Every combat turn, potion use and target
[*]Events, chests, elite relics, gold and potion rewards
[*]Rest vs Smith, and your map path
[/list]

With 2 players it's a swap; with 3 or 4 it's a ring in seat order. Everyone picks for their neighbour at the same time, so nobody waits. If your picker stalls, you get a "Choose myself" button. Nothing is ever chosen for you automatically.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[b]Everyone in the lobby needs this mod.[/b] Built for v0.107.1.

Settings: ringdraft_config.json in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2 (created on first launch). Each player can turn off shop delegation, card-effect choices and more, and change the timeouts. Problems? Post ringdraft_log.txt from the same folder.
